answer: A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a fleet in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because every identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The hollow cap is checked at intake and falcon publishes the per-origin counts. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a spiral tag. That is 27 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
